name: Squat Thrust
summary: A four-count bodyweight conditioning exercise where you squat, jump back to a plank, hop back to a squat, and stand upright.

setup: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms resting at your sides.
steps: Bend at your hips and knees to descend into a deep squat, planting your palms flat on the floor roughly shoulder-width apart.
Jump both feet backward simultaneously to land in a rigid high plank position with your core braced and body in a straight line.
Hop both feet forward quickly, landing outside or just behind your hands in a stable squat posture.
Push through the floor with your legs and extend your hips to stand fully upright to complete the rep.
instructions.breathing: Inhale as you squat down and jump back into plank, then exhale forcefully as you hop your feet back forward and stand up.
cues: Hands down, feet back, feet in, stand tall.
Brace your abs to keep your hips from sagging in plank.

common_faults.fault: Hyperextending the lower back and letting the hips dip excessively upon jumping back into plank.
common_faults.correction: Squeeze your glutes and actively engage your abdominals before your feet touch down behind you.

common_faults.fault: Landing solely on the toes with knees collapsed inward when hopping feet forward.
common_faults.correction: Hop feet forward wide enough so that your entire foot can plant securely on the floor.

precautions: Ensure the floor surface is dry and non-slip before performing ballistic jumps.
